glyph_origin: Ideogrammic compound (會意): 木 (“tree”) + 目 (“eye”) – an eye looking at a tree — original character for 相 (“to observe”). Later phonetically borrowed (假借) to represent 相 (“mutually”).
senses: [xiāng] to see for oneself; to evaluate by seeing for oneself
[xiāng] mutually; reciprocally; towards each other; one another
[xiàng] to look at; to examine the appearance and judge; to observe
